definitions.full: H4375. Makpelah מַכְמֵּלָה proper name, of a location near Hebron , where the patriarchs and their wives were buried, only in P, always with article; בַּמּ אשׁר ׳שׂדה Gen 23:17 , הַמּ ׳מְעָדַת the cave of Machpelah 23:9 , 25:9 , הַמּ מְעָרַת׳שְׂדֵה 23:19 ; 50:13 , הַמּ בִּשְׂדֵה אֲשֶׁר ׳מְעָרָה 49:30 . — compare Buhl Geogr. 160, 161. — (Evidently originally appellative, but meaning dubious; ᵐ5 τό διπλοῦν ; according to Thes = part, lot , portion , as Ethiopic ).
